question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​Sum of the position values of the first two letters according to the English alphabetic series is 28.

​So,

 
• CXA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e74692fd1318c65b3964ad376ffb31322a8f39a64638f8115dc99edfd49eecdb.png] 

 
• UGS

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7a3f934fd143ee15d192908cdd8af96289e12e2128aab44eaa6398d63be132f.png] 

 
• JRH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/604e2c5e4545c3554572cdee72081221ff65796d3cd3f12dbfddd5508b02f05a.png] 

 
• NNL

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7ccf5b05ab019953c173dd48482d5465ec28b20484f7b75026021fcdb2d27dc.png] 

Thus, out of all options only 'CXA' sum of the position values of the first two letters according to English alphabetic series is 27 instead of 28.

Hence, **"CXA"** is the correct answer.
